public.description: Publicly shareable information such as docs, marketing copy, and non-sensitive demo data.

internal.description: Internal operational data that is not personal, restricted, or secret.

confidential.description: Sensitive business or user-adjacent data that requires redaction or approval before model use.

restricted.description: Raw personal records, production DB rows, session/auth data, and other high-risk content.

secret.description: Credentials, keys, tokens, passwords, DB URLs, and other secret-bearing material.

openRouter.notes: OpenRouter is restricted to public/internal data by default.

directProviders.notes: Direct OpenAI/Anthropic may receive carefully reviewed confidential data only when task policy allows it.

batchRules.notes: Batch is for non-blocking work only and rejects confidential/restricted/secret data by default.

logRules.notes: All logs require redaction scan before persistence.

evidenceRules.notes: Evidence should reference artifacts rather than persist sensitive blobs.

uiRules.notes: UI payloads should expose redacted summaries and evidence references, not sensitive raw content.
